meta.title: Item reskins: SRD 5.2 item -> flavored display name (names and flavor only)
meta.version_file: tables/item-reskins.version.json (sha256, built_at, entry_count, diff); history in tables/item-reskins.CHANGELOG.md

id_scheme.id: srd_id = stable kebab-case SRD item id (examples: 'quarterstaff', 'chain-mail', 'explorers-pack'). Never changes once published.
id_scheme.stored_on_sheet: The sheet stores srd_id for every item (not the display name).
id_scheme.fallback: If srd_id is missing on a sheet entry, fall back to srd_name (exact, case-insensitive); then to legacy_names (older /create junk names).
id_scheme.prices: Prices always key off srd_id, never the display name (the Accountant must not price by display text).

meta.display_rule: Show combined_label = 'Display Name (SRD Name)'. Names and flavor only: damage, properties, mastery, AC, weight, price and every other 5e rule are untouched. One display_name + one snark line per 5e item.
meta.tone: DCC dungeon-crawl gallows humor, mild snark, adult table okay. Crawlers, never 'champ'. snark <= 25 words.
meta.name_priority: 1) loot-deck reskin_name when the same 5e item is a deck card (name_origin 'deck:<card id>'); 2) chargen-5e.json junk name ('chargen', or kept in legacy_names when replaced); 3) new house name ('new').
meta.source_tag: HOUSE for every SRD-equivalent entry; CANON for the non_srd canon items (heal-critter-potion: M-090, K-121; pet-carrier: I-012), whose ledger_ref lists the ledger ids. No DCC book item shares a name with an SRD mundane item in CANON-LEDGER.md (closest: I-009 'Healing Potion' ~ Potion of Healing, kept HOUSE). ledger_ref is null on HOUSE entries.

non_srd_fields.non_srd: true on canon/house items that have no SRD 5.2 entry (heal-critter-potion, pet-carrier). Their srd_name says '(canon item, no SRD entry)'. base_price is null on purpose (price_flag explains) and they ARE purchasable; they are not generic headers.
non_srd_fields.price_credits_proposed: Vending price in credits at Floor-1 scale (Accountant proposal; times the floor multiplier at runtime; buyback half). null for SRD items. Syndicate to confirm in the pets rule.
non_srd_fields.mechanic_note: Short rules note for non-SRD items (null for SRD items). Numbers inside it flagged 'Syndicate to set' are suggestions only.

meta.floor_variants: Reserved: per-floor alternate display names/snark. Empty for now.

price_fields.base_price: SRD 5.2.1 cost as a string, e.g. '2 gp' (null if the SRD gives no single price).
price_fields.base_price_cp: Same price as an integer in copper (1 gp = 100 cp, 1 sp = 10 cp). null when base_price is null.
price_fields.price_note: Source note for a price that is not a plain SRD 5.2 table value (e.g. spellbook: 'SRD 5.1 gear table, Accountant ruling').
price_fields.resolve_to_variant: true on generic 'Varies' category headers (arcane-focus, druidic-focus, holy-symbol, gaming-set, musical-instrument, artisans-tools). They are NOT purchasable and must be resolved to one of their `variants` srd_ids before /create or a vending wall shows or prices them.
price_fields.source: SRD 5.2.1 'Equipment' tables (weapons, armor, adventuring gear, ammunition, foci) and tool/instrument/gaming-set entries, read 2026-10-04 from D&D Beyond free rules. Reference only; Vending Wall pricing stays with the Accountant.

meta.scope_not_covered: Mounts, vehicles, tack, services, lifestyle/food prices (not item reskins); magic items (see loot-decks); specific spell scrolls (deck cards name them).
